name: boarding-pass
title: Boarding Pass
description: A boarding pass with route, gate and an expandable barcode.
useCases: On a trip screen, a passenger expands the boarding pass to check their seat, gate and boarding time.
In a connecting itinerary, the app shows a separate pass for each flight so the traveler can distinguish the legs of the trip.
task: A boarding pass with route, gate and an expandable barcode.
behavior: Provide display-ready airport, flight, seat and gate labels. boarding holds the displayed boarding time.
